title: Trolley token — STEP conversion versus the original STLs
notes: Original design by jhappone, Thingiverse 4126950, CC BY 4.0. The conversion itself makes no design changes (rigid print placement only); it is compared here rendered with M2_HARDWARE = false, without CanFactory's fittings for the M2 screw, nut and torsion spring (CONVERSION.md).
Clip.print.stl is the supplied Clip.stl rotated 180 degrees about X; the supplied originals remain unchanged.
The STEP clip carries a 0.26138493093829307 degree assembled tilt. The conversion flattens its outer face for printing, then the assembly pose reverses this rigid transform.
